verdict.rationale: Orrick's Technology Transactions practice page explicitly names advising on open source policy development and compliance, and on dual-licensed open source and proprietary software, for its emerging tech company clients. This covers both OSS compliance and usage-policy counseling as a stated service. Missing for 10: a dedicated OSS practice page or in-depth description of the service scope, and independent or client corroboration of the open-source counseling work.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability

citations.quote: dual-licensed (i.e., open source and proprietary) software, and otherwise advising on open source policy development and compliance
we advise more than 3,000 emerging technology company clients on commercial agreements, technology transactions, sell-side M&A and financings
